name: Shizhe Yu Daocaoren Yiqi Shenghuo
original_name: 試著與稻草人一起生活
source:
There's a valley between mountains and having a lot of people who are both kind and nice.

A young man, Norbert is working hard as a farmer everyday.

One day, in the morning, he found his field had been destroyed.

"Your scarecrow has been already old and torn, hasn't it?
That might be the reason your field got attacked. How about you make a new one?"

A piece of advice from others reminded Norbert of his scarecrow.

--Scarecrow.
Right, a new scarecrow is needed indeed...

Norbert was thinking like that when going home. Then, he met——

...that girl lying on the road, stretching her arms wide and looking at the sky.

[From [url=https://hoi-hoi-hoi.itch.io/living-with-a-scarecrow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
山间有一个山谷，有很多善良而友善的人。

诺伯特是一个年轻人，每天都像农民一样辛苦地工作。

有一天早上，他发现自己的田地被毁了。

“你的稻草人已经又旧又破了，不是吗？
这可能就是你的领域受到攻击的原因。要不你再做一个新的怎么样？”

别人的一个建议让诺伯特想起了他的稻草人。

 - 稻草人。
是的，确实需要一个新的稻草人……

诺伯特回家的时候也是这么想的。然后，他遇见了——

……那个女孩躺在路上，张开双臂，看着天空。

[来自[url=https://hoi-hoi-hoi.itch.io/living-with-a-scarecrow]Itch.io[/url]]
